snippet.title: Akatori – Official Gameplay Trailer | World‑Switching Metroidvania Adventure
snippet.description:
Akatori gameplay, Akatori trailer, metroidvania game, pixel art action platformer — Akatori is a world‑switching metroidvania featuring fast‑paced combat, exploration, platforming, boss battles, and staff‑based abilities. This official gameplay trailer follows Mako across interconnected realms shaped by the Amber Storms, highlighting traversal, upgrades, and the signature staff‑switching mechanics that define the Akatori experience.

Play as Mako, a young battle monk who travels across interconnected worlds to uncover ancient secrets and stop a looming catastrophe. Explore diverse biomes, fight powerful enemies, unlock new abilities, and discover the truth behind the Amber‑infused corruption spreading across the land.

🎮 Platforms & Release Information
PlayStation 4/5 — Launching August 12, 2026. Available to wishlist now.  

Xbox One / Xbox Series X|S — Launching August 12, 2026. Available for pre-order.  

Nintendo Switch — Planned for late Q3 2026 or Q1 2027.

Steam — Launching August 2026. Available to wishlist now.  

✨ What You’ll See in This Trailer
World‑switching exploration

Staff‑based combat and traversal
Hand‑crafted pixel art environments
Boss battles and unique enemies
Metroidvania progression and ability upgrades

🔔 Stay Connected
Follow the development of Akatori, wishlist the game on your preferred platform, and don’t miss upcoming updates, trailers, and announcements.
